title: A High-Frequency Trading Approach and System for Power Market Transactions
content: With the increasing complexity and volatility of modern power markets, high-frequency trading (HFT) has emerged as a promising approach to enhance market efficiency and liquidity. This paper proposes a high-frequency trading methodology and system tailored for power market transactions. The approach leverages advanced algorithmic techniques, including predictive modeling, real-time data analytics, and adaptive decision-making processes, to capitalize on micro-level price movements and optimize trade execution. We introduce a novel system architecture that integrates market data feeds, trade execution modules, and risk management tools, enabling rapid responses to market dynamics and improving overall trading performance. Through simulations and case studies, we demonstrate the effectiveness of this method in capturing arbitrage opportunities, reducing transaction costs, and enhancing market stability. The proposed HFT framework offers a potential solution to address the growing challenges in power markets, particularly in terms of price discovery, liquidity provision, and market efficiency.
